scope: Gate 2 logistics scope, version, role, and ownership decision only

roles.LBNP: Logistics Buyer Network Participant; currently the Retail Seller NP that fills the order; protocol BAP

official_contract.compatibility: 1.2.5 is side-by-side compatible with 1.2.0; feature discovery is required and RTO is not fully backward compatible

decision.counterparty_version_rule: Accept 1.2.0 only when the selected LSP advertises it; never silently reuse the Retail 1.2.0 mapper
decision.initial_product_scope: One B2C Immediate Delivery P2P forward-fulfilment lifecycle; no batch, P2H2P, reverse, RTO, NDR, ePOD, shipping-label, or LSP-support feature until separately admitted

roles.ondcbuyer.aadharcha.in: Retail BAP only; read-only consumer of persisted tracking state

ownership.agentguard: Authorize consequential create, confirm, update, and cancel logistics actions
ownership.commerce_v1: Own order, fulfilment, and customer-visible tracking state
ownership.gateway_ondc_adapter: Own server-side protocol mapping, signing, verification, Registry lookup, inbox/outbox, idempotency, retry, and callback correlation
ownership.external_lsp: Own logistics quotes and operational fulfilment events
ownership.browser_apps: Hold no ONDC signing keys or Registry credentials

p4_entry_evidence: Redacted PreProd Registry or portal evidence that ondcseller.aadharcha.in is subscribed as an ONDC:LOG10 BAP/LBNP
An approved PreProd LSP identity with BPP subscriber ID, URI, SUBSCRIBED lookup, supported version, and enabled feature list
One local deterministic signed contract fixture proving version mapping, ACK/NACK, correlation, replay rejection, and no mutation without AgentGuard
claim_boundary: No logistics API call, order, payment, FQDN/Auth0 journey, production-money action, official conformance run, or later gate was executed.
